hourly.summary: Pre-match jitters ahead of the Chelsea trip dominate — gallows humour about conceding early and desperate hope that a Mainoo-Baleba pivot might actually function. Transfer rumours (Batrakov, Barça targets) and Carrick's captaincy dilemma with Bruno add to the sense of a club grasping for solutions.

daily.summary: Sentiment deteriorated from grim to fully doomed across the day, with fans progressing from forensic post-mortems on Ten Hag's transfer failures to outright panic ahead of the Chelsea trip. Owner hatred, tactical incoherence, and a perceived beaten dressing room dominate, while the Mainoo dependency and relegation talk underscore a fanbase that has abandoned hope. The mood is not just negative — it's resigned to collapse.

weekly.summary: Manchester United fan sentiment remained locked in a sustained, week-long catastrophe with scores barely moving from 2/10 across all seven days. The 4-1 Champions League thrashing by Como and a 3-0 home humiliation to Bournemouth bookended a period defined by total loss of faith in Carrick, the Glazers, and INEOS, with the mood hardening from grim resignation into open revolt — anti-ownership chants, serious relegation talk, and gallows humour as the only coping mechanism. No meaningful improvement occurred; the week ended in full-blown freefall.
